corrections.correction: Full Table 1 gives 5734–5603 cal BP for UOC-21868, rather than the abstract's rounded 5735–5600. Separate F001 samples date 5555–5324 and 5462–5316 cal BP. Do not fill the temporal gap as continuous residence.
Hackenberger et al. concern Boiling Rock on Barbuda, not Malmok, Canashito or St. Michielsburg. Correct Aruba support comes from Kelly and Hofman's 2019 chapter and the official heritage inventory.
Mitchell's Canary Islands review is off Africa and cannot support Bonaire fortifications or ABC archaeological dates.
The supplied prose is an excerpt, not a verified article title, and the matching primary indexed page bears J. Tacoma's name. Do not accept the input author-date metadata.
This is a book review of Regional Settlement Demography in Archaeology, not a primary ABC chronology or a review of The Caribbean before Columbus.
A long regional/site research record and a 26-site synthesis do not demonstrate uninterrupted occupation of every ABC island for six millennia.
Local isotope compatibility does not prove birthplace or exclude movement between islands with overlapping baselines. Eight sampled individuals do not constitute a resident census.
Preserve original 1821–1960; numerical display ends 1934 solely because of the application cutoff, not abandonment.
C-1426 establishes pre-5000 cal BP evidence on Curaçao; failure to verify comparably early Aruba or Bonaire evidence does not demonstrate that no people were present there.

corrections.target: Colonization models and DNA route claims
corrections.correction: Curaçao's proximity to South America is not direct proof of a northern-first Antillean route. Genetic affinities and archaeological associations do not identify a precise path, language or ethnic group.
Distinguish 7000 calendar years BP from 7000 BC. Keegan/Hofman publisher date is 2017; Sidestone is a publisher, not an author. Keep online versus issue years explicit.
Title's approximately 3300 BP is radiocarbon language; primary text supplies 1875–1520 cal BC at 2σ. Do not relabel the site as 3300 BC.

corrections.target: Uniform Ceramic Age onset and contact cessation
